p: Keilah: Which was a city in the tribe of Judah, Jos 15:44.
Judah: That is, in the midst of Judah, much more when we come to the borders against our enemies.
ephod in his hand: By God's providence the ephod was preserved and kept with David the true king.
Bring hither the ephod: To consult with the Lord by Urim and Thummim.
delivered him not into his hand: No power nor policy can prevail against God's children, but when he appoints the time.
king over Israel: Jonathan assured David, that God would accomplish his promise, and that his father warred against his own conscience.
Blessed be ye of the LORD: the Lord recompense this friendship.
land: In your country of Ziph, which is in Judah.
Maon: Which was also in the tribe of Judah, Jos 15:55.
messenger unto Saul: Thus the Lord can pull back the bridle of the tyrants and deliver his out of the lion's mouth.
Selahammahlekoth: That is, stone of division, because there they divided themselves one from another.
strong holds at Engedi: That is, in strong places, which were defended by nature.
